annotations.text:
Proposed direction: field manual with Costa Rican warmth.
Type: Archivo (UI + display) with IBM Plex Mono for data (part numbers, dates, fitment).
Palette: warm paper #F7F4EE, ink #2B2620, rust accent #B0532A, Montero green #3E6B4F for positive states; amber/red reserved for triage and safety.
Two alternate directions on the Directions page — pick, mix, or redline anything here.
All costs, times, odometer readings and source links are SAMPLE data for layout only — real entries come from the garage backfill (T303) and problem research (T403).
Direction alternates, low-fi on purpose. The main templates are built in the proposed direction; these show how far the same bones can move. Say the word and any of these becomes the direction.
